verdict.rationale: Multi-entity and multi-currency accounting is a fair question for an expense and spend management product, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of running several legal entities in one account, consolidated cross-entity reporting, or per-entity books. Related items cover other things: SmartScan reading a receipt's currency, multiple currencies on invoices, configuring workspaces, and syncing a workspace to QuickBooks Online or NetSuite.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books
